size.label: Size
size.description: Uniform size multiplier for the gameplay spring and its trigger

snap_to_center.label: Snap to Center
snap_to_center.description: Start the launch at the spring origin

rehit_cooldown.label: Rehit Cooldown
rehit_cooldown.description: Seconds before the same body can trigger this spring again

strength.label: Strength
strength.description: Base launch speed in meters per second

stop_momentum.label: Stop Momentum
stop_momentum.description: Replace existing velocity during an impulse launch

additive_mode.label: Additive Mode
additive_mode.description: How existing velocity is combined when Stop Momentum is off

min_additive_launch_speed.label: Minimum Additive Launch Speed
min_additive_launch_speed.description: Minimum speed in the launch direction when Stop Momentum is off

max_additive_launch_speed.label: Maximum Additive Launch Speed
max_additive_launch_speed.description: Cap on impulse speed along the launch direction. Zero disables the cap

additive_mirrored_bounce_ratio.label: Mirrored Bounce Ratio
additive_mirrored_bounce_ratio.description: Blend inward motion toward a mirrored bounce during an impulse

damping_grace_time.label: Damping Grace Time
damping_grace_time.description: Seconds before airborne launch damping can return

detach_from_ground.label: Detach From Ground
detach_from_ground.description: Release ground adhesion when the spring launches the player

launch_axis.label: Launch Axis
launch_axis.description: Spring-local impulse axis when the trajectory solver is off

use_trajectory_solver.label: Use Trajectory Target
use_trajectory_solver.description: Aim at the spring-local target and enable generated arcs

trajectory_target_offset.label: Target Offset
trajectory_target_offset.description: Endpoint relative to the spring, in Blender local axes and meters

trajectory_aim_origin.label: Impulse Aim Origin
trajectory_aim_origin.description: Aiming origin for an impulse. Player Position requires Snap to Center to be off

trajectory_arc_enabled.label: Follow Arc
trajectory_arc_enabled.description: Follow a generated curve to the target. Requires Use Trajectory Target

trajectory_arc_height.label: Arc Height
trajectory_arc_height.description: Maximum curve offset in meters along the selected up direction

trajectory_arc_speed.label: Arc Speed
trajectory_arc_speed.description: Travel speed in meters per second. Zero uses Strength

trajectory_arc_up_mode.label: Arc Up
trajectory_arc_up_mode.description: Reference direction for the arc's height

trajectory_arc_allow_input_cancel.label: Arc Input Cancel
trajectory_arc_allow_input_cancel.description: Allow movement input to release the player from the arc

movement_lock_time.label: Movement Lock
movement_lock_time.description: Seconds to lock steering. The player continues to travel

action_lock_time.label: Action Lock
action_lock_time.description: Seconds to lock actions after triggering the spring

align_time.label: Alignment Time
align_time.description: Seconds to constrain an impulse launch to the launch direction

override_previous_lock_timers.label: Override Previous Locks
override_previous_lock_timers.description: Clear earlier movement, action and alignment locks when triggered

clear_movement_lock_on_ground.label: Clear Movement Lock on Ground
clear_movement_lock_on_ground.description: Allow landing to end the spring's movement lock

clear_action_lock_on_ground.label: Clear Action Lock on Ground
clear_action_lock_on_ground.description: Allow landing to end the spring's action lock

lock_horizontal_during_align.label: Lock Sideways Motion
lock_horizontal_during_align.description: Constrain sideways velocity while the impulse alignment timer is active

sideways_gravity_influence.label: Sideways Gravity Influence
sideways_gravity_influence.description: Amount of sideways motion allowed during impulse alignment

align_model_during_spring.label: Align Player Model
align_model_during_spring.description: Orient the character model along the spring launch or path

homing_target_enabled.label: Homing Target
homing_target_enabled.description: Register the spring as a homing attack target

homing_target_max_distance.label: Homing Range
homing_target_max_distance.description: Maximum homing distance in meters. Zero uses the character's range

preserve_active_flight.label: Preserve Active Flight
preserve_active_flight.description: Keep an already-active flight ability during an impulse launch

preserved_flight_time_bonus.label: Flight Time Bonus
preserved_flight_time_bonus.description: Seconds added when the current flight ability is preserved

mesh_bounce_enabled.label: Mesh Bounce
mesh_bounce_enabled.description: Animate the spring mesh when triggered in Godot

mesh_bounce_axis.label: Bounce Axis
mesh_bounce_axis.description: Local axis scaled by the mesh bounce

mesh_bounce_peak_scale.label: Peak Bounce Scale
mesh_bounce_peak_scale.description: Maximum multiplier along the bounce axis

mesh_bounce_duration.label: Bounce Duration
mesh_bounce_duration.description: Seconds for the native bounce animation. Zero disables the animation
